metadata.title: Earth land topography visualization, GEBCO_08
metadata.source: NASA Earth Observatory / GEBCO / British Oceanographic Data Centre
metadata.attribution: Imagery by Jesse Allen, NASA Earth Observatory, using GEBCO data produced by the British Oceanographic Data Centre.
metadata.license: GEBCO_08 derivative educational/research/noncommercial reproduction permitted with credit, plus NASA media guidance. Commercial use requires consulting original GEBCO_08 terms; this asset is outside the code MIT license.
notes: Unmodified downloaded JPEG; a genuine elevation visualization, not a normal map or current terrain observation.
NASA documents image values scaled to 0-6400 meters. JPEG quantization/clipping and source resolution prevent survey-grade elevation measurements.
Use as a labelled topography overlay. Any bump or displacement exaggeration must be labelled separately.
The provider does not state a single acquisition epoch for the compiled elevation dataset.
